roundoff_justification: binary64 unit eps, generous operation-count budgets for scalar products, two-leg chain rule and correctly rounded fsum; positive forward+reverse scales avoid net-rate conditioning. MP guard leaves 10 of 80 decimal digits for elementary operations and at most 408 terms. These are computational cross-check budgets, not base/hires accuracy tolerances.
difference_scale: arithmetic mean of base and hires positive forward+reverse sums for the same test function
